_doc: Machine-readable exam format (structure only, no exam content). Counts/times checked against the official pages in verified.sources on verified.date; criteria descriptions are LexKite's own wording. Read by scripts/content-qa/exam-format-check.mjs (docs/CONTENT-QA.md §6).
name: TOEFL iBT (format from 21 January 2026)
total_minutes_note: base time 30+29+23+8; allow about 2 hours including directions; adaptive sections can vary

sections.name: Reading

tasks.name: Complete the Words
tasks.note: fill missing letters of words in a short academic paragraph

tasks.name: Read in Daily Life
tasks.note: short everyday texts (notices, messages, schedules) with MCQ

tasks.name: Read an Academic Passage
tasks.note: short academic passage with MCQ on main idea, detail, vocabulary

sections.per_task_note: ETS gives only the section total; the split between tasks varies by adaptive route

sections.name: Listening
sections.per_task_note: ETS gives only the section total; the split between tasks varies by adaptive route

sections.name: Writing

tasks.name: Build a Sentence
tasks.note: arrange given words/phrases into a correct sentence or question

sections.per_task_note: 10+1+1 = ETS section total 12; task minutes are LexKite practice timings consistent with the 23-minute section

scoring.overall: mean of the four section scores rounded to the nearest half band
scoring.legacy: comparable 0–120 total also reported for two years after January 2026
scoring.unscored_if: any section has no answered item

writing.focus: Email covers every point for the reader and purpose; discussion post takes a clear position and adds to what classmates said.
Ideas are explained with reasons, details or examples, not just listed.
Accurate, varied grammar and precise vocabulary; tone fits the reader.

speaking.focus: Repeated sentences match the model word for word.
Pronunciation, stress and pacing are easy to follow.
Interview answers are relevant, developed and use appropriate grammar and vocabulary.
